subject: Merchantly — multi-region sawtooth spike, partial-credit assessment and evidence request
messages:
From: ops@merchantly.com
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: sara.patel@merchantly.com
Date: 2029-12-01T02:12:00Z
Subject: Sawtooth spikes across us-west/us-east — 11/30 20:05–20:28 UTC — impact on invoice API

Ben —

We observed repeated sawtooth 429/503 spikes impacting our invoice processing pipeline last night. Impact window we see in our logs: 2029-11-30 20:05:12 UTC through 2029-11-30 20:28:46 UTC (roughly 23 minutes), with short recoveries and then a 5‑minute recurrence at ~20:42. Overall throughput dropped ~45% and retries spiked which caused delayed batches to miss our nightly cut.

We need:
- Confirmation from Redwood on whether this maps to any capacity event or routing fallback on your side.
- Eligibility for a proportional SLA credit under Section 4.2 of our contract (monthly availability guarantee).
- Raw request/response traces for the 20:05–20:30 window and any operator notes if there were restarts/failovers.

Attaching our flow-level summary (inline) — will follow up with full traces if you confirm where/how to upload logs to you. This is blocking our finance team; please escalate.

Thanks,
Sara Patel
Head of Ops, Merchantly
ops@merchantly.com

Attachment: merchantly-summary-11-30.csv (33KB)
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: ops@merchantly.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, irene.choi@redwood.ai
Date: 2029-12-01T03:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Sawtooth spikes across us-west/us-east — 11/30 20:05–20:28 UTC — impact on invoice API

Sara —

Thanks for the heads up and the summary. I'm escalating this to SRE and the account team now. Quick notes / next steps from our side: 

1) We've opened internal incident SUP-8742 and assigned an on-call to pull runtime traces and autoscaler events for the windows you listed.
2) To speed verification, please confirm whether Merchantly observed increased client-side retry loops (number of retries per request) — that helps us map retries vs server-side 429s.
3) We'll provide an initial eligibility check for a proportional credit within 24 hours once we have the raw traces; once validated, finance will calculate the credit per the contract.

CC'ing Marissa (your account lead) and Irene (SRE) to coordinate evidence and timeline. Ben

--
Ben Carter
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: irene.choi@redwood.ai
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@merchantly.com
Date: 2029-12-01T08:17:12Z
Subject: Re: Sawtooth spikes across us-west/us-east — evidence bundle attached

On Wed, Dec 1, 2029 at 03:05, ben.carter@redwood.ai wrote:
> Sara —
> 
> Thanks for the heads up and the summary. I'm escalating this to SRE and the account team now. Quick notes / next steps from our side:
> 
> 1) We've opened internal incident SUP-8742 and assigned an on-call to pull runtime traces and autoscaler events for the windows you listed.

Folks — attaching the initial evidence bundle for the 20:05–20:30 window. Contents (attachment stub):
- sawtooth-raw-logs.tar.gz (log bundle, 120MB) — includes per-shard access logs, gateway traces, and autoscaler events.
- trace-span-sample.json — 5k trace spans sampled across 3 regions.

Preliminary observations (high level):
- There were repeated short-lived schedule preemptions on a subset of autoscaling pools in us-west-2 (nodes restarted by orchestrator for kernel update; we have operator note that a rolling kernel patch started at 20:03 UTC).
- Smart-routing fell back to secondary replicas for approx. 90 seconds twice during the window; fallbacks correlate with higher median tail latency and increased 429s from the gateway.
- No full region outage — just localized pool restarts.

I recommend we:
- Share the log bundle with Merchantly for their verification (permission to upload to a Merchantly S3/Share?).
- Proceed with a provisional proportional credit calculation while we finalize the RCA.

Attaching SUP-8742 link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/SUP-8742

--
Irene Choi
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: ops@merchantly.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, irene.choi@redwood.ai
Date: 2029-12-01T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Sawtooth spikes across us-west/us-east — provisional credit and postmortem request

Hi Sara —

Thanks for the quick reply and for sharing the summary. Per Irene's bundle (attached) and our internal events:

- Summary: localized rolling kernel patch during your window caused short preemptions on a subset of autoscale pools in us-west-2. These triggered smart-routing fallbacks twice, each lasting about 60–90 seconds, which aligns with the sawtooth 429 spikes you observed.

- Eligibility: Under Section 4.2 we evaluate proportional credit for availability gaps. Based on the verified impacted time (two fallback periods totalling ~3 minutes of degraded availability inside the 23‑minute span you reported), we propose a provisional credit equal to 0.12% of the monthly invoice for November (calculation details below). This is provisional pending Merchantly confirmation of the exact set of affected API keys and client-side retries.

Provisional credit calculation (high level):
- Contracted monthly availability target: 99.95%
- Aggregated verified impaired time: 00:03:00 (3 minutes) across affected routes
- Proportional credit: (3 minutes / total minutes in month) * invoice portion for affected routes = ~0.12%

Request from you:
1) Confirm the API key(s) that experienced the increased retry volume so we can match request IDs to Merchantly account.
2) Grant upload access (or specify preferred secure upload) for Redwood to push the log bundle and trace sample so you can independently validate.
3) Confirm whether Merchantly wants Redwood to produce the formal postmortem (we can deliver a customer-facing RCA and timeline within 5 business days).

If you confirm the keys and accept the provisional calculation, we'll route the credit through finance and schedule a short joint postmortem review. If you prefer to wait for a final RCA before the credit is applied, let us know — we can hold the provisional amount in escrow while we close SUP-8742.

Thanks again — we'll keep this prioritized.

Ben
--
Ben Carter
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 415 555 0132
